=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:363, 377 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The production snapshot calls use `--source`, routing to the legacy builder that includes non-ignored untracked files instead of the tracked-only sanitized snapshot.
  WHY: Read-profile containers can access untracked workspace files, including sensitive files, defeating the stated isolation boundary.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:359-386 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The runtime uses the legacy snapshot builder, which creates a synthetic single-commit repository, and passes `--omit-claude-md` instead of the `--omit-root-claude-md` option for the new snapshot path.
  WHY: Read-profile roles that inspect repository history see no source commits, branches, or refs, causing Git commands to fail or produce inaccurate diagnoses.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:367, 370-372, 380, 383-385 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The shell gates on `git_objects`, a field neither snapshot path supplies with a meaningful value, so it cannot detect omitted Git metadata.
  WHY: When the new snapshot path omits Git history due to object alternates, the fallback gate remains false and the container runs without history.
- tests/test_claude_read_isolation_wiring_contract.py:14 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts a workflow script list substring that does not match the actual list because `claude_settings.json.tmpl` appears between the cited entries.
  WHY: Running the test raises an assertion failure and fails the test suite.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:405 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The emitted log line uses `CLAUDE_ISOLATION` and omits the documented `CLAUDE_READ_ISOLATION` prefix and its `outcome`, `reason`, `files`, and `git` fields.
  WHY: Consumers of the documented log contract cannot identify or parse isolation outcomes; reviewers rated severity from NIT through BLOCKER, so the highest severity is used.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py:424 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The assertion pins the old `CLAUDE_ISOLATION` prefix and field shape instead of the documented `CLAUDE_READ_ISOLATION` contract.
  WHY: Updating the runtime log line to match the contract will cause this regression test to fail.
- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py:762-763 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The post-fetch deadline check can report that the time budget was spent during log fetch even when a short configured budget and quick fetch caused the ten-second reserve to trigger.
  WHY: The warning can misidentify the cause of fallback for any positive digit-only budget below ten seconds.
- scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py:762-765 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The ten-second reserve is an unnamed literal, and its buffer semantics are duplicated independently from the per-call timeout logic.
  WHY: Future changes to the per-call timeout or reserve can leave the values inconsistent and cause Claude calls to be dropped too early or started too late.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "Maintain access to sanitized task data and needed Git history."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated
  confidence=[5]

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:363 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `_ai_engine_py read-snapshot --source "${workdir}"` routes to the legacy builder, which includes untracked files and creates a synthetic repository rather than using the tracked-only snapshot with real Git metadata.
  WHY: Untracked files can be read inside the container, and roles requiring repository history see a synthetic single-commit repository.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:377 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The extra-directory snapshot call uses `--source` and routes to the legacy builder rather than the tracked-only snapshot path.
  WHY: Untracked files in heal worktree checkouts, including locally created artifacts or credential-bearing files, are mounted in the read-only container.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:367, 370-372, 380, 383-385 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The shell extracts `.git_objects`, but the snapshot results do not provide a meaningful `git_objects` value for gating omitted Git history.
  WHY: If object alternates cause the snapshot to omit Git history, the fallback gate does not block the container from running without history.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:405 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The emitted log line uses `CLAUDE_ISOLATION` and omits the documented `CLAUDE_READ_ISOLATION` prefix and fields.
  WHY: Log parsers and telemetry relying on the documented prefix and contract cannot observe or parse the isolation outcome.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Run read-profile roles in a filesystem-isolated container containing only sanitized task data; keep token files, Git credentials, and runner files outside it, and broker model access without mounting credentials." (from LINKED ISSUE, Recommendation section). The plan auto-decision AD-2 chose Option A: "a network-isolated container, read-only, with the OAuth token kept on the host relay and a placeholder inside the container. The container gets a sanitised copy of the workdir in which .git is kept but credential-bearing config is stripped."
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh:_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated, lines 362-365 (the snapshot invocation) and lines 367-372 (the git-objects gate)
  Evidence of absence: Lines 363 and 377 pass `--source` instead of `--workdir`, routing every read-profile snapshot through `build_read_snapshot` (legacy untracked-file path) instead of `read_snapshot` (new tracked-file-only path with sanitized real git metadata). The `read_snapshot` function was added to `claude_engine.py` at lines 1372-1393 and wired into `cmd_read_snapshot` at line 1533-1534 specifically for this purpose, but the runtime caller does not use it. The `CLAUDE_READ_ISOLATION` log prefix documented at agents.md:1475 is not emitted — line 405 still emits `CLAUDE_ISOLATION` without the required outcome/reason/files/git fields.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py line 762
  Issue: The literal `10` in `time.monotonic() + 10 >= claude_deadline` is a magic number without documentation.
  Suggested minimal fix: Extract to a named constant at module level, e.g. `_CLAUDE_PRE_CALL_GRACE_SECONDS = 10`, and use it in the condition.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/summarize_unselected_runs.py line 763
  Issue: The warning message says "during log fetch" but the time budget may have been exhausted for reasons unrelated to the fetch (e.g., previous summarizations consumed the budget).
  Suggested minimal fix: Change "during log fetch" to "before starting run summary" or similar.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
